attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Load balancer name. Up to 32 characters, letters, digits and hyphens only.

attributes.name: load_balancer_type
attributes.description: Application balances HTTP/HTTPS; network balances TCP/UDP at layer 4.

attributes.name: internal
attributes.description: Reachable only from inside the VPC. An internal load balancer needs private subnets.

attributes.name: enable_deletion_protection
attributes.description: Block accidental deletion. Worth enabling for anything serving production traffic.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Tags applied to the load balancer.
